protocol.tune: six visible cases; two runs for with_skill and old_skill; one focused-ablation run
protocol.holdout: one generation-blind run per variant; expected behavior and review rubric withheld from answer tasks; no post-score tuning

excluded_infrastructure_attempt.reason: sandbox DNS blocked the model endpoint; all task return codes were nonzero and usage telemetry was missing

limitations: Raw answer and judge transcripts are retained only in the local /private/tmp run tree and are not reviewer-accessible; the receipt hashes prepared tasks, answer outputs/metadata, retained judge-result files, and final reports, but not raw transcript files.
Visible tune cases measure targeted regression behavior.
The one-shot holdout is generation-blind but its fixture and oracle were designed in this iteration; it is limited forward evidence, not broad generalization proof.
Neither revised model cleared the 0.85 holdout judge threshold; the result was not used for post-score tuning.
